MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  MARCH 5, 2018

A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
order at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chambers, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by
CHAIRMAN MEDAWAR.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  CHAIRMAN MEDAWAR led the assembly in the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.

3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Chair Medawar, Zigrang, Schachter, Scott, Carman, Edler

  Commissioners Absent:  Yoo

  Student Commissioners:  Hsu, Grimes

  Staff Present:  Planning Director Wahba, Associate Planner Thom

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER to,

  APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING OF
  FEBRUARY 5, 2018.

  There being no objection, CHAIR MEDAWAR so ordered.

5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  None

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A. WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL RESOLUTIONS THAT ARE PRESENTED FOR THE
  CONSIDERATION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION ON TONIGHT’S AGENDA AND
  ALL SUCH RESOLUTIONS SHALL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER moved, seconded by VICE CHAIR ZIGRANG to,

  APPROVE ITEM 6-A.

  There being no objection, CHAIR MEDAWAR so ordered.

7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  None

8.  CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A. PLANNING APPLICATION NO. 01-18; APPLICANT: MR. AND MRS. SAL AGUILAR;
  LOCATION: 25914 CHALMETTE LANE; A request to approve a Neighborhood
  Compatibility Determination to demolish the existing single-story residence and garage
  and construct a new one-story residence with an attached three-car garage. A Minor
  Deviation is requested to decrease the side yard setback by less than 10%. A
  Variance is requested to encroach into the required front yard beyond the forwardmost
  building line. A second Variance is requested to decrease the front yard area by more
  than 10%. A Grading application is requested to create a usable horsekeeping area in
  the rear yard.

  Associate Planner Thom stated that the applicant has redesigned the project to provide
  the full 35 ft. rear yard setback, which eliminated the second Minor Deviation, the size of
  the home was reduced, and the grading will follow the existing grade.

  1
Planning Commission Minutes
March 5, 2018
   Associate Planner Thom stated that staff is able to support approval of the project as
  presented.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT confirmed that the home looks 2’ narrower and moved forward
  approximately 8” when the guest house was removed from the plan and asked if there
  was a change in grading. Associate Planner Thom responded that there will be no change
  in the grading.

  Jeff Lyon, Architect, stated that he is available for any questions.

  CHAIR MEDAWAR stated that the guest house, which is not part of this proposal, was
  moved to the other side of the property and asked if the square footage is being allocated
  to meet the setback requirements for the neighbors. Mr. Lyon stated that is meets all the
  zoning requirements regarding side and rear setbacks and it is out of the way of any
  concerns the neighbors may have.

  Ernie Bumatay, 25918 Chalmette Lane, stated that he is the neighbor to the right as you
  face the subject property and stated that he is not aware of the change to the guest house.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT stated that the guest house is not part of this proposal.
  Planning Director Wahba stated that the guest house will be an administrative approval.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER to,

  CLOSE THE PUBLIC HEARING.

  AYES: CHAIR MEDAWAR, ZIGRANG, SHACHTER, SCOTT, CARMAN, EDLER
  NOES:
  ABSENT: YOO
  ABSTAIN:

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG to,

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION No. 01-18

  AYES: CHAIR MEDAWAR, ZIGRANG, SHACHTER, SCOTT, CARMAN, EDLER
  NOES:
  ABSENT: YOO
  ABSTAIN:

  Planning Director Wahba stated that the Planning Commission has approved Planning
  Application No. 01-18. There is a 20-day appeal period.

9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER asked if the HOA’s are being notified about the CalWater
  project. Planning Director Wahba stated that staff will be sure to send the notifications to
  all of the HOA’s. There will be a lot of outreach by CalWater and the City on this project.

  VICE CHAIR ZIGRANG asked about the future plans for the nature center property.
  Planning Director Wahba stated that the City has been applying for grants. The plan is to
  build a new nature center and community room. This will be an item discussed at the
  City Council Policy Development Session scheduled on March 13th.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN asked if the General Plan Advisory Committee will be
  working on the uses for these parcels. Planning Director Wahba responded yes.

10.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

  Planning Director Wahba stated that the planning department is reviewing administrative
  cases at this time, therefore, the Planning Commission meeting in April may be cancelled.

11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A. DRAFT MINUTES OF PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMITTEE MEETING, FEBRUARY 20,
  2018.

  B. CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, FEBRUARY 13, 2018.

  C. CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, FEBRUARY 27, 2018.

  2
Planning Commission Minutes
March 5, 2018
   COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved, seconded by VICE CHAIR ZIGRANG to,

  RECEIVE AND FILE ITEMS 11-A THROUGH 11-C.

  There being no objection, CHAIR MEDAWAR so ordered.

12.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR MEDAWAR adjourned the meeting at 7:17 p.m.
